cases.expected: Returns the ObjectMapper instance that was injected into the JsonSchemaFactory (the same reference as the jsonMapper field).
cases.description: Create a JsonSchemaFactory instance (via its Builder or a subclass in the same package) and set its private jsonMapper field to a mock or real ObjectMapper. Invoke getJsonMapper() and verify that the returned mapper is exactly the one that was set, confirming the true branch of the ternary operator.

Instantiate a JsonSchemaFactory without providing a custom ObjectMapper, leaving the jsonMapper field null. Call getJsonMapper() and assert that the result equals JsonMapperFactory.getInstance(). This covers the false branch of the ternary operator.
Using a spying technique (e.g., Mockito.spy on JsonMapperFactory), verify that getJsonMapper() triggers a single call to JsonMapperFactory.getInstance() when the internal jsonMapper field is null.

cases.expected: The same ObjectMapper instance is returned on successive calls and JsonMapperFactory.getInstance() is invoked only once.
cases.description: Create a JsonSchemaFactory without supplying a custom ObjectMapper (jsonMapper field is null). Call getJsonMapper() twice and capture the returned instances. Assert that both references are identical and use a Mockito spy on JsonMapperFactory to verify that getInstance() was called exactly once, confirming that the method does not repeatedly request the default mapper.

cases.expected: Returns the custom ObjectMapper that was supplied to the builder.
cases.description: Use JsonSchemaFactory.builder() (or the overload that accepts a blueprint) and invoke a hypothetical builder method setObjectMapper(customMapper) before building the factory. Call getJsonMapper() and assert that the returned mapper is the same reference as customMapper, exercising the true branch of the ternary operator via the public builder API.

cases.expected: Falls back to JsonMapperFactory.getInstance() when the builder is instructed to use a null mapper.
cases.description: Construct a JsonSchemaFactory via its builder, explicitly passing null to the mapper configuration (e.g., .setObjectMapper(null)). After building, invoke getJsonMapper() and verify that the result equals JsonMapperFactory.getInstance(), thereby covering the false branch when the field is intentionally set to null.

cases.expected: All threads receive the identical default ObjectMapper instance and JsonMapperFactory.getInstance() is called only once.
cases.description: Instantiate a JsonSchemaFactory with no custom mapper. Spawn a pool of several threads (e.g., 10) where each thread calls getJsonMapper() and stores the result in a thread‑safe collection. After all threads complete, assert that every stored reference is the same object and verify via a spy that JsonMapperFactory.getInstance() was invoked a single time, proving that the method behaves correctly under concurrent access.

cases.expected: getJsonMapper() returns null when JsonMapperFactory.getInstance() returns null.
cases.description: Mock (or spy) JsonMapperFactory so that its static getInstance() method returns null. Create a JsonSchemaFactory with a null jsonMapper field and invoke getJsonMapper(). The method should propagate the null result, allowing verification that no NullPointerException is thrown and that the fallback path simply returns whatever the factory supplies.

Mock (e.g., with PowerMockito) the static method JsonMapperFactory.getInstance() to throw a RuntimeException. Create a JsonSchemaFactory instance with a null jsonMapper field and invoke getJsonMapper(). Verify that the same RuntimeException bubbles up, confirming that the method does not catch unchecked exceptions from the fallback factory.

Configure the static JsonMapperFactory.getInstance() to throw an Error such as NoClassDefFoundError. Call getJsonMapper() on a factory whose jsonMapper field is null and assert that the Error propagates unchanged.

group: jsonMapper field access triggers exception via custom subclass

cases.description: Create a subclass of JsonSchemaFactory (inside the same package) that overrides the jsonMapper field with a getter method that throws a RuntimeException when accessed (e.g., by using a custom ObjectMapper implementation whose method invoked during field read throws). Invoke getJsonMapper() and verify that the exception is thrown, demonstrating that any exception while reading the field is not swallowed.
